titleVi: Gọi đồ uống ở quán cà phê
situation: A small coffee shop in the morning. The learner wants to order a drink, choose a size and pay.
goalVi: Gọi một đồ uống, chọn cỡ ly và trả tiền.
opening: Hi! Welcome to Sunny Cafe. What can I get for you today?
keyPhrases: Can I have a small one?

situation: The first day of an English class. The learner meets a classmate and they introduce themselves.
aiRole: a friendly new classmate named Emma
goalVi: Giới thiệu tên, quê quán và công việc của bạn.
opening: Hi! I'm Emma. I'm new here. What's your name?

situation: A fruit stall at a market. The learner wants to buy some fruit and asks about prices.
goalVi: Hỏi giá và mua hai loại trái cây.
opening: Good morning! Fresh fruit today. What would you like?

situation: A busy street in a city. The learner is lost and asks a local person how to get to the train station.
aiRole: a helpful local person on the street
goalVi: Hỏi đường và hiểu cách đi tới nhà ga.
opening: Hi, you look a bit lost. Can I help you?

situation: Two friends chat at lunch. The friend asks the learner about their family.
goalVi: Kể về các thành viên trong gia đình bạn.
opening: Tell me about your family. Do you have any brothers or sisters?
keyPhrases: There are four people in my family.

situation: A casual restaurant at dinner time. The learner orders a main dish and a drink and asks about the menu.
goalVi: Gọi món chính, đồ uống và hỏi về một món trong thực đơn.
opening: Good evening! Here's the menu. Are you ready to order, or do you need a few minutes?

situation: The front desk of a hotel. The learner has a booking and wants to check in and ask about breakfast.
goalVi: Nhận phòng đã đặt và hỏi giờ ăn sáng.
opening: Good afternoon, welcome to the Riverside Hotel. Do you have a reservation?
keyPhrases: I have a reservation under the name...

titleVi: Mua áo ở cửa hàng quần áo
situation: A clothes shop. The learner wants to buy a shirt, asks for another size and tries it on.
goalVi: Tìm áo đúng cỡ, hỏi thử đồ và quyết định mua.
opening: Hello! Are you looking for anything special today?
keyPhrases: Do you have this in a medium?

situation: A phone call between friends. They plan to see a movie this weekend and agree on a day, time and place.
goalVi: Chọn ngày, giờ và nơi gặp để đi xem phim.
opening: Hey! Are you free this weekend? I want to see the new movie.

situation: A small clinic. The learner feels sick and describes the problem to a doctor.
goalVi: Kể triệu chứng và hiểu lời dặn của bác sĩ.
opening: Hello, please sit down. What seems to be the problem today?
keyPhrases: I've had a fever since yesterday.
How often should I take it?

titleVi: Làm thủ tục ở sân bay
situation: An airport check-in desk. The learner checks in for an international flight, asks for a window seat and their bag is a little overweight.
goalVi: Làm thủ tục, xin ghế cạnh cửa sổ và xử lý hành lý quá cân.
opening: Good morning. May I see your passport and ticket, please? Where are you flying today?
keyPhrases: Could I have a window seat?
How much is the extra charge?
Can I take this as hand luggage?

situation: A restaurant. The learner's food is cold and not what they ordered, and they politely complain.
goalVi: Phàn nàn lịch sự và đề nghị đổi món hoặc giảm giá.
opening: Hello, I'm the manager. The waiter said there's a problem with your meal. What happened?
keyPhrases: I'm afraid this isn't what I ordered.

situation: A phone call to a landlord about an apartment for rent. The learner asks about the price, location and what is included.
goalVi: Hỏi giá thuê, vị trí, tiện ích và hẹn ngày xem nhà.
opening: Hello, this is Mark. You're calling about the apartment on Green Street?
keyPhrases: Is it close to a bus stop?

situation: A coffee break at work. A colleague asks the learner about their recent holiday.
goalVi: Kể nơi bạn đã đi, đã làm gì và cảm nhận về chuyến đi.
opening: Welcome back! How was your holiday? Where did you go?

situation: A phone call to a dentist's office. The learner can't come to their appointment and needs a new time.
aiRole: a receptionist at a dental clinic
goalVi: Xin đổi lịch hẹn và chọn được giờ mới phù hợp.
opening: Bright Smile Dental, how can I help you?
keyPhrases: I'd like to change my appointment.
Do you have anything on Friday afternoon?

situation: A job interview for an office position at an international company. The interviewer asks about experience, strengths and goals.
aiRole: an HR manager interviewing the learner
goalVi: Giới thiệu kinh nghiệm, điểm mạnh và lý do bạn muốn làm công việc này.
opening: Thanks for coming in today. To start, could you tell me a little about yourself and your experience?
keyPhrases: I have three years of experience in...
I'm looking for a role where...

situation: A meeting with a manager after receiving a job offer. The learner wants a higher salary or better benefits.
goalVi: Thương lượng lương hoặc phúc lợi một cách chuyên nghiệp.
opening: We're very happy to offer you the position. Do you have any questions about the offer?
keyPhrases: I was hoping for something closer to...

titleVi: Trình bày ý tưởng với sếp
situation: A short meeting at work. The learner proposes an idea to improve the team's work and answers the manager's questions.
aiRole: a busy but open-minded team manager
goalVi: Trình bày ý tưởng, nêu lợi ích và trả lời câu hỏi của sếp.
opening: You wanted to talk to me about an idea? I have about ten minutes. Go ahead.
keyPhrases: We could start with a small trial.

titleVi: Tranh luận về làm việc từ xa
situation: A friendly debate between colleagues about whether working from home is better than working in the office.
aiRole: a colleague who prefers working in the office
goalVi: Nêu quan điểm của bạn, đưa lý do và phản biện ý kiến của đồng nghiệp.
opening: Honestly, I think people work better in the office. Don't you agree?

titleVi: Xử lý khiếu nại của khách hàng
situation: The learner works in customer service and answers a call from an unhappy customer whose order arrived late and damaged.
goalVi: Lắng nghe, xin lỗi và đưa ra giải pháp làm khách hài lòng.
opening: Hi, I ordered a lamp two weeks ago. It arrived yesterday and it's broken. This is really disappointing.
keyPhrases: I'm really sorry to hear that.
We can send you a replacement or a full refund.
